slides.headline: I feared Meta scraping my site. Now they say no.
Meta added broad AI training clause
slides.body: It said Meta could use any content from business account sites to train AI.

slides.headline: Experts warned it allowed site scraping
slides.body: Legal experts said this let Meta scrape publisher websites for AI model training.

slides.headline: Meta said crawling didn't change
slides.body: A spokesperson insisted the updated terms didn't reflect a change in how Meta crawls the web.

slides.headline: Verge reports clause removed
slides.body: The Verge says Meta deleted the language and clarified it applied only to ads and business products.

slides.headline: Follow for AI news
slides.body: Get simple updates on what AI means for your life.
